sloka: तस्य बुद्धिरियं जाता चिन्तयानस्य सन्ततम् ।स्वयं वरं तनूजाया: करिष्यामीति धीमत: ॥ २.११८.३८॥
transliteration: tasya buddhiriyaṁ jātā cintayānasya santatam ।svayaṁ varaṁ tanūjāyā: kariṣyāmīti dhīmata: ॥ 2.118.38॥

translations.english: After constantly pondering over the matter, the wise king arrived at the decision to perform a swayamvara for his daughter.
